data.one_liner: Flutter Naver Login SDK package for authentication via Naver in South Korea
data.what_it_does: Provides Naver login, logout, account unlinking, user profile retrieval, and pre-built Naver login buttons for iOS and Android.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app targeting South Korean users where Naver login is required
You want native Naver login SDK integration with iOS and Android support
avoid_when: Your application does not target the South Korean market
You only need standard OAuth providers like Google or Apple
strengths: Official Naver Login integration for Flutter
Provides pre-built Naver login and logout UI widgets
Supports both iOS and Android platforms
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only iOS and Android)
Requires manual native configuration in iOS Info.plist and Android ProGuard if used
data.setup_notes: Requires registering an application on the Naver Developer Center to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret, configuring URL schemes in iOS Info.plist, and calling NaverLoginSDK.initialize in main().

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Apple authentication instead of regional South Korean login providers.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Google sign-in capabilities instead of Naver.
